title: Stabilization of Integral Difference Equations by Solving a Corona Problem
summary: This paper proposes a stabilizing state-feedback control law for vector-valued state systems with a scalar control input, governed by a general class of integral difference equations that incorporate both pointwise and distributed input delays. The proposed controller is expressed through integral operators acting on the state and input histories over a finite time horizon. Closed-loop stability is established by characterizing the controller kernels as solutions to a convolution equation arising from a Corona problem.
